verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents a CLI for operating an existing instance from a terminal, including task examples. It also offers a public REST API with a live OpenAPI spec and an SDK generated from it, so it can be scripted without the UI. Nothing shows it actually running in CI pipelines or describes a non-interactive mode. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CI usage docs or examples, non-interactive auth (API tokens) for automation, CLI command depth beyond a README pointer, independent hands-on corroboration.
